source.commit_body:
Resolves the =5 put dip and the broader weak-weekly underperformance
pattern documented in known-issues.md Priority #13.

Mechanism: when overall < 28 AND weekly_adj > -17 (weekly didn't
strongly confirm bearish thesis), lift score toward 50 by:
    weakness = clip((wadj + 17) / 17, 0, 1)
    overall  = round(overall + 0.95 * weakness * (50 - overall))

Calibration via Phase 4 Bayesian (1300+ variants in fast_variant_runner):
    K = 0.95            (lift coefficient)
    wadj_cutoff = -17   (strong-weekly boundary)
    score_gate  = 28    (only lift puts < 28)
    lift_target = 50    (push toward neutral)
    linear-clip weakness (tanh leaks lift into strong-weekly territory)

Per-trade evidence (5y diff-assess vs current production):
    <10 WR15 +4.0pp (73.4 -> 77.4)
    <15 WR15 +3.0pp (72.6 -> 75.6)
    <25 WR15 +5.9pp (68.2 -> 74.1)
    70+ WR15 +0.0pp (calls untouched)
    Put N    -75%   (65k -> 16k; put:call ratio 5:1 -> 1.4:1)

Discriminator validation (experiments/put_wadj_cross_buckets.py):
    =5 split by wadj quartile: Q1 84.1% / Q4 58.8% (delta -25.2pp on N=69/68)
    Pattern extends across every put bucket (-7 to -15pp); call-side
    smaller (-2 to -9pp) — gate kept put-only.

Weight_info exposes 'wcf_lift' for explain-scores audits when active.

Validated rounds:
    Phase 1 (tanh weekly amplifier modulation)        -> per-trade null
    Phase 2 (K-axis floor sweep)                       -> K=1.0 dominant
    Phase 3 (refined Bayesian K0.85_W-18_T42_G28)      -> +2.55 util
    Phase 4 (deep 1300-variant sweep)                  -> K0.95_W-17_T50_G28 +0.32
    Phase 5a (multi-stage / call-mirror / gate ext)    -> all redundant given lift
    Phase 5b (floor + tanh weekly amp combo)           -> running

Canonical 3-mode MC validation pending recalculate.
